context: Yumiko and Naoko cook seasonal dishes together — autumn.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ゆみこちゃん、栗、たくさん、もらってきた。
lines.en: Yumiko-chan — I brought back so many chestnuts.
lines.style: Warm announcement with genuine delight. Opens bright and generous. Slight lean-in, as though offering a gift. Tone is affectionate-familial, no performance. Real pleasure at having something to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、ありがとう。秋ね、本当に、感じる。
lines.en: Oh, thank you. You really can feel autumn coming, can't you.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative warmth. Pause after the opening, taking a moment to genuinely register the gesture. Speaking as much to herself as to Naoko. Reflective but not wistful — grounded in the present moment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 栗ご飯、作ろうか。お母さんも、好きだったし。
lines.en: Let's make chestnut rice — Mother loved it, you know.
lines.style: Practical warmth shifting toward memory. Proposes the idea as natural continuation, not performance. Slight fondness enters the voice when mentioning the past. Inviting rather than directive.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんも、毎年、楽しみにしてた。
lines.en: Father looked forward to it every year.
lines.style: Tender, holding the memory without breaking. Quiet certainty in her voice. Not heavy, but present — the kind of thing said to keep someone close without saying so directly.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お父さん、絶対、空から、見てくれてる。
lines.en: He's watching from above — I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Soft conviction, almost a quiet prayer. Warmth without sentimentality. Said with simple faith, not as comfort but as fact. Settling gently into the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こうやって、季節、ちゃんと、感じられるの、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so glad we can feel the seasons properly like this.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Speaking more inward than outward — a reflection that lands gently. Tone is both grateful and grounded. No dramatic pause, just genuine presence in what she's noticing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 美味しく、作ろうね。皆で、食べましょう。
lines.en: Let's make it delicious — all of us together.
lines.style: Warmth that invites without insisting. Inclusive and gathering. Final word carries the weight of the moment — togetherness as the real point. Soft close, hands together.
